```{r}
#| label: check-confounding-factors
tar_load(sets_confounding_factors)
tar_load(parsed_grouped_statuses)
tar_load(sets_qc_color)


pc1_scores = sets_confounding_factors |>
  dplyr::filter(PC %in% "PC1")
color_and_scores = dplyr::inner_join(sets_qc_color, pc1_scores, by = "analysis_id")

color_and_scores |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(statistic), y = overall_status)) + geom_sina() + geom_vline(xintercept = log10(5000))

color_and_scores |>
  ggplot(aes(x = -1 * log10(p.value), y = overall_status)) + geom_sina() + geom_vline(xintercept = -1 * log10(1e-50))

red_yellow_pca = dplyr::bind_rows(parsed_grouped_statuses$match[[3]], parsed_grouped_statuses$match[[4]])
red_yellow_scores = dplyr::left_join(red_yellow_pca, pc1_scores, by = "analysis_id")

red_yellow_scores |> dplyr::filter(p.value <= 1e-10, statistic >= 300, percent >= 0.3) |> dplyr::arrange(analysis_id) |> View()
```
